yuejie.name: Yue Jie Zhang
yuejie.bio: Software engineer with 2+ years leading the development and operations of hospital OPD/ED systems across 93 servers in Paraguay — serving over one million patient visits every month. Built and maintained the core HIS stack (Java · PostgreSQL · Tomcat), then led a progressive frontend modernisation to Next.js (React + TypeScript), replacing legacy JSP with minimal disruption. Engineered deep integrations with LIS and PACS: bi-directional lab data exchange and DICOM-standard QIDO-RS queries that let clinicians access medical images directly in their workflow. Co-built the team's hiring process, coding standards, and documentation culture, and introduced AI-assisted development tools to accelerate knowledge transfer. Now applying that production-hardened instinct to design tailored software and AI workflows for businesses.
